column1: # Schedule RC-R Part I -- Regulatory Capital.
# Two things about this schedule are easy to get wrong
# 1. THE BASEL I -> BASEL III CHANGE IS A PREFIX CHANGE. The same MDRM item codes carry
#    the same concepts on either side
#    A variable pointed at either one alone goes blank for half the panel. The base items
#    below are era-suffixed and the derived series stitch them.
# 2. THE REPORTED RATIOS CHANGE UNITS THREE TIMES (measured 2026-09-26; the earlier
#    belief that they are confidential from 2015Q1 was wrong -- they are ~98% populated
#                                     bulk files; data_call_report stores the number
#    The base rows below are era pieces of one code; the derived *_reported series
#    rescale the percent eras by 1/100 and publish FRACTIONS
#    ratios (tier1_capital / rwa). The computed ratios remain the primary series; the
#    reported ones are published for validation and for the CBLR banks that report a
#    leverage ratio but no RWA from 2020Q1.
# Part II -- the ~740-cell risk-weighted-asset grid -- is not covered.
